01 / Overview

CompanyOS is an AI-powered business system that runs all of a company's operations from one platform. It uses RootOS's intelligence to cover day-to-day work across departments, people and projects.

02 / The problem

Most companies run on a patchwork of ERP, CRM, HR, task and finance tools. Leadership has no single view, data is copied between systems by hand, and the software only records the work — someone still has to plan it, chase it and report on it.

03 / Our approach

CompanyOS brings the leadership dashboard, HR, projects and tasks, sales and CRM, finance, marketing and client delivery into one platform and connects the systems a company already has. On top of it, AI agents plan, coordinate and monitor the work and — where appropriate — carry it out, preparing reports and recommendations for management.

04 / The result

The aim goes beyond a classic ERP or task manager: not just recording work, but planning, coordinating and controlling it through AI agents. CompanyOS is built for small, mid-sized and large companies, service businesses, digital agencies, manufacturers and technology firms. The capabilities on this page describe the product's planned scope as development continues.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. AI that executes, not just records

    AI agents plan, coordinate and monitor the work and, where appropriate, carry it out — with automatic reports and recommendations for management.

  2. Connects what you already use

    Integrates with existing ERP, CRM, HRM, communication and other business systems instead of forcing a full replacement.

  3. The business layer of the ecosystem

    Runs on RootOS's intelligence, receives decisions from MeetOS and hands software work to AgentOS.
